scope: Static source inspection only; no app import, DB access, runtime UI or browser verification.
limitations: Literal dependency extraction; dynamic template/static construction may require manual review.
Static route extraction excludes implicit Flask HEAD/OPTIONS and built-in static endpoint.
Effective assets are transitive set membership; do not infer runtime load order from this list.
Style attribute counts are lexical source counts, not rendered DOM counts.
No-runtime-reference is a review candidate, not automatic deletion authorization.
Routes are associated with renders at function level; conditional aliases such as ai_reports may redirect instead of rendering.
